The '''Taroon system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Rseik sector/Legends|Rseik sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Kuan]] and [[Bordal]]. It was in [[Imperial Space]].
